acceptance_scenarios: AS-1 preliminary cap render (M5-T003 AS-1 fixture BBL 1000010100, 200 preliminary): Compare renders a ranked scenario card whose draft residential FAR floor-area cap is shown VERBATIM from the endpoint body (test asserts the rendered value === the body value; the client NEVER recomputes it), labelled draft/needs_review, with the optimized objective + score breakdown; the cap is never displayed as certain by color alone (a text label is always present).

AS-2 no_scenario / professional-review fixture (M5-T003 AS-2 body, scenario_kind no_scenario): the screen renders a visible reason + review-required label + preserved share ranges (never collapsed) and NO cap, and remains usable (an informative result, never an error page).

AS-3 coverage labels: verified / conditional / review-required / conflict / unsupported each render with a distinct TEXT label (not color-only) and the 8 MISSING envelope families from coverage_matrix are visibly listed as gaps.

AS-4 contract-safety (mirrors src/lib/api.ts S2/S3): every 200 body is runtime-validated against scenario@1.0.0 BEFORE any render; a body whose (HTTP status, state) pair is outside the documented matrix, or that fails validation, renders a distinct bounded error outcome carrying only the allowlisted correlation id - nothing partially rendered.

AS-5 flag-off / upstream failure / timeout: the generic 404 (INTERNAL_SCENARIO_ENABLED off) and the documented source_unavailable/rate_limited/timeout/schema_drift states each render a recoverable, non-leaking state with the correlation id; never a raw stack, secret, or invented scenario.

AS-6 navigation: the Confirm 'Next step' dead-end now routes to the Compare screen for the confirmed BBL with one clear next action; forward and back navigation preserve the analysis; the control is keyboard-reachable and labelled.

AS-7 offline / no-credentials (proves D-038-R004): AS-1..AS-6 run entirely under vitest with mocked/fixture endpoint responses (committed M5-T003 fixtures) and/or the Playwright e2e against apps/web/e2e/harness/fixture_api.py - NO network, NO Supabase, NO Geoclient.

AS-8 accessibility: outcome is announced to assistive tech (aria-live), focus is managed on step transition, headings are semantic, and no material state is encoded by color alone (jest-axe / RTL assertions).
risks: Recomputing/deriving the cap in the client instead of surfacing the endpoint value verbatim (AS-1 guards this; the client transports+validates+classifies, it never computes zoning values - docs/PRODUCT_FLOW_AND_AI_BOUNDARIES.md).
Encoding legal certainty by color alone or up-labeling a needs_review value (AS-3/AS-8 guard this).
Rendering a body before contract validation, or routing by state alone rather than the (status,state) pair (AS-4 guards this).
Editing the read-only property client/templates or the built contract (forbidden_paths guard).
